title: Callvale before: every request goes to one Region
claim: Every request travels from the user to the load balancer or bucket in one Region.
alt: Before: users, some far from the United States, send every request to an Application Load Balancer and web instances in US East (N. Virginia). Recordings come from the private bucket callvale-audio through presigned URLs.

edges.label: every request
edges.say: Every request goes to the one Region.
Web instances serve pages and static files.

edges.label: presigned URL
edges.say: Recordings play through presigned URLs from the bucket.
